title.en: An act establishing a National Science High School in Barangay Jalaud in the Municipality of Barotac Nuevo, Province of Iloilo to be known as Jose Monfort National Science High School, appropriating funds therefor and for other purposes
title.orig: An act establishing a National Science High School in Barangay Jalaud in the Municipality of Barotac Nuevo, Province of Iloilo to be known as Jose Monfort National Science High School, appropriating funds therefor and for other purposes
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường Trung học Khoa học Jose Monfort Quốc gia tại Barangay Jalaud, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này, và cho các mục đích khác
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาวิทยาศาสตร์ Jose Monfort แห่งชาติ ในบารังไกย์ Jalaud และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้ และเพื่อวัตถุประสงค์อื่น
title.id: Undang-Undang membentuk Sekolah Menengah Sains Jose Monfort Nasional di Barangay Jalaud, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu, dan untuk tujuan lain
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Menengah Sains Jose Monfort Kebangsaan di Barangay Jalaud, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu, dan untuk tujuan lain

text.en: there shall be established under the supervision of the Department of Education (DepEd), a national science high school in Barangay Jalaud, Municipality of Barotac Nuevo, Province of Iloilo to be known as the Jose Monfort National High School.
The site of said national science high school shall be located within the compound of the Jose S. Monfort State College, Barangay Jalaud, Barotac Nuevo, Iloilo.
The DepEd shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purposes of this Act.

The Secretary of the DepEd shall immediately include in its program the operationalization of the Jose Manfort National Science High School, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
